relevance_note: Systematic review of LCAT deficiency plus first-hand description of three Mexican probands and their kindred with LCAT variants ("we describe the biochemical and genetic investigation of three previously unreported Mexican probands and their kindred with LCAT deficiency syndromes"); literature individuals are taken from single-case rows of Table 1, Supplementary table 5 and the Discussion.
method_note: Worked by reading the whole paper (main text, Tables 1-4, converted supplementary files); the JSON was assembled by a Python script in my scratch directory from values I read, and table-row spans were cut from the Markdown rows by script and checked by hand against the tables. Scope: (a) first-hand: the three Mexican probands and the relatives described in Table 4 and the case text; (b) previously published individuals only where the paper gives individual-level data: Table 1 rows with Sample Size 1 (Korean, Australian, Danish, Romanian, Argentinian, Chilean, Colombian, Ecuadorian, Lebanese, Pakistani; labels 'Table 1 row k' with k counting data rows and skipping the bold ethnic-group band rows), the 20 rows of Supplementary table 5 (unclassified patients; Author column copied into source_reference_in_review), and four people named in the Discussion (refs [22], [46], [64], [88]). Multi-case rows of Table 1, Table 2 and the Brazilian 38-case group are aggregate and give no rows. Table 1 single-case rows: values like 'Yes:1'/'No:1' read as this person's status because Sample Size is 1; the 'Median Age' column is recorded as age at diagnosis because the abstract calls the review's age 'age of diagnosis'; 'Hemolytic Anemia No' excludes only hemolytic anemia (not anemia); eGFR <60 'Yes' was taken as chronic kidney disease or renal failure observed, 'No' excludes nothing on the checklist; premature CHD 'No' excludes nothing on the checklist. Table 1 nucleotide cells concatenate several variants without separators; I split them at each 'c.'; the Korean cell 'c.794_801dec.633dupG' was split into 'c.794_801de' and 'c.633dupG' (the first string looks truncated). Table 3 rows for Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador were treated as the same people as the Table 1 single-case rows (text says one case each); Table 3 Mexican row 'c.110 C > T | FLD | 34 | M' was treated as the ref [88] (Posadas-Sanchez) man of the Discussion; Table 3 rows for proband 1 (37 F Trp8*), proband 2 (70 F FED) and proband 3 (29 F c.490 C > T) match the case text. Supplementary table 5: 'N' is defined as 'no' in its legend (quoted as second span); 'Unk' and blanks = not reported; Markdown escapes '\>' were removed from variant values (spans keep them). Relatives: Proband 1's affected brothers are Table 4 'Brother1 (III-2)' and 'Brother2 (III-1)' identified via 'Two brothers were affected (homozygotes)', the bold rows and 'The 2 remaining siblings and both parents' (Brother3, Sister); the sentence '2 brothers had corneal opacities and nephrotic syndrome' was assigned to them as a group statement. Pedigree labels repeat across families (II-1, III-1, III-2), hence '(Family 1/2)' suffixes, family = the Table 4 group label. The last Table 4 row 'Father (II-1)' has no family group cell; labelled 'Table 4 row 15' (probably proband 3's father, but not stated) and kept separate from 'parent of PROBAND 3' rows, so it may duplicate one of them. Proband 2's mother (coronary artery disease, died at 70) was left out: neither tested nor described as affected. One of the 4 studied grandchildren of proband 2 is not in Table 4 and has no row. Mahapatra et al. family (FLD proband, FED sister and mother, cited as [88]) left out: no individual-level fact beyond diagnosis for the proband. Inheritance of proband 1's and her brothers' homozygous Trp8* left 'not reported' because both parents are heterozygous and the enum has no 'both parents' value; the parental statement is recorded. Daughters of proband 2 recorded 'inherited maternal' (their mother, proband 2, carries both variants). Transcript NM_000229.1 is from the Methods reference-sequence sentence and was applied to the three Mexican families only. 'Trp8*' is printed without 'p.' and also as 'Trp-17*'. Proband 1 biopsy: 'mesangial proliferation' and 'vacuolated macrophages' recorded as features but not mapped to the checklist items 'mesangial expansion' or 'glomerular foam cells'; 'intramembranous lipid deposits in glomerular capillaries' mapped to GBM lipid deposits. Proband 2 'no evidence of ... renal disease' excludes chronic kidney disease/renal failure and nephrotic syndrome. Contradictions in the paper: proband 3's variant is 'c.490 C > T' (Table 3 and Results) but the case text says 'a G to A substitution on codon 140 converting Arginine to Histidine'; proband 2's HDL-C is 11 mg/dL in the text but 12 in Tables 3 and 4; proband 1's specific LCAT activity is 3.7 in text and 3.79 in Table 4; proband 1's 'Only her paternal grandmother had eyes similar to hers' vs '2 brothers had corneal opacities'; the ref [88] man is 'unclassified ... (probable FED)' in the Discussion but 'FLD' in Table 3; the Argentinian case is FED in Table 1 but Unclassified in Table 3; the Ecuadorian case is FED in Table 1 but FLD in Table 3; the Australian single case has 'FED:2'; the review total is 215 in the text and 216 in Table 2; ref [88] is cited both for Posadas-Sanchez and for Mahapatra et al.
